Relevant roles: jobs whose title is one of "Bookkeeper", "Accounts Assistant", "Purchase Ledger Clerk", "Finance Assistant" (a "freelance" or contract version of these titles counts too). Every other job is not a relevant role.
Months of experience: count calendar months in relevant roles from the start month to the end month, both included (Mar 2021 - Jun 2022 is 16 months).
